company_name: Nomura Shanghai Engineering Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in water treatment systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nomura Shanghai Engineering Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of ultrapure water and wastewater treatment systems, crucial for semiconductor fabrication. The company focuses on delivering high-quality solutions that ensure the integrity of water used in semiconductor processes.

regional_presence.China: The company operates as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise in Shanghai, focusing on the local semiconductor market.
